get.description: Retrieve the financial profile for the default user.

put.description:
Create or partially update the financial profile.

Omitted fields retain existing values; explicit null clears fields; explicit 0 stores zero.
Enforces emergency_reserve <= existing_savings on the effective combined profile.
Synchronizes active goal allocation without falsely clearing capping status if data becomes unknown.

get.description: Retrieve the currently active financial goal for the default user.

put.description:
Create or update the single active financial goal.

Requires an existing financial profile.
Rejects past deadlines and invalid monetary inputs.

get.description:
Evaluate deterministic feasibility of the active goal against the saved profile.

Translates domain timeline errors to HTTP 422 and missing entities to HTTP 404.
Incomplete profile baseline inputs return INSUFFICIENT_DATA with null metrics.
